title: Disposal requests
purpose: Follow every disposal request from request to approval to recorded disposal. Each disposal needs approval by a different person who holds disposal approval.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: All roles can read the list. There is no New button: a request is started from the specimen's record with Request disposal.

Approving is an explicit permission given to named people. It is not part of any role and superuser status does not grant it. Nobody can approve a request they made themselves, even when they hold the permission.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the specimen ID. Without a filter all requests are listed, newest first. Click Request or Specimen to sort; click again to reverse. Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page (default 25). Invalid filters show an error and no rows.

items.label: State
items.description: Awaiting approval, Approved, not yet disposed, Out of date, Rejected, Cancelled or Disposed.

items.label: Awaiting my approval
items.description: Shown only to people who hold the approval permission. Lists pending requests made by other people, which you may approve or reject.

items.label: Awaiting approval
items.description: Requested and not yet decided, and the specimen is unchanged since the request.

items.label: Approved, not yet disposed
items.description: Approved and waiting for someone to dispose of the material and record it.

items.label: Out of date
items.description: The specimen changed (moved, checked out, amount changed, and so on) after the request or after the approval, so the request cannot be used. A new request is needed.

items.label: Rejected, Cancelled
items.description: Ended without disposal. The request stays in the history.

items.label: Disposed
items.description: The disposal was recorded; the specimen record and history are kept.

items.label: Request
items.description: Request followed by the date and time; opens the request. Sortable, newest first on first click. Always shown.

items.label: Specimen
items.description: The specimen ID; opens the specimen. Sortable.

items.label: Method, Destination
items.description: How and where the material is to be disposed of, as written in the request.

items.label: Requested by
items.description: The person who made the request.

items.label: Decided by
items.description: The person who approved, rejected or cancelled it, or a dash.

sections.title: Export CSV
paragraphs: All four staff roles can download disposal-requests.csv. Apply a search or filters, choose the sort order, then select Export CSV. Requested by me and Awaiting my approval use the signed-in account. Only checked personal filters appear in the active filter list. The file includes all seven register columns across all matching pages, even when a column is hidden on screen.

Request gives the time in UTC with its offset. State is the state when the register is exported. Decided by is blank until someone records a decision. A selection with no matches downloads the column headings.

Narrow the filters when more than 10,000 requests match. Correct invalid filters before downloading. Each successful export records your account, the applied filters, sort order and row count in the audit trail.

sections.title: Empty states
paragraphs: With no requests the page says “No disposal requests yet”. With filters that match nothing it says “Nothing matches these filters”. The dashboard counts link here with the matching state or Awaiting my approval already applied.
